exclusion_policy: Reject the whole grid window on any overlap; never consult index presence, length or outcomes when drawing.
question: What fraction of eligible 16-slot windows contain at least one mint with an admitted buy in slots [start,start+8) and an admitted sell in [start+8,start+16)?
estimand: Window-level probability of an ordered pair in the frozen decoder-admitted event tape, separately in each epoch half. Not market-wide activity, holding period, executable roundtrip or profit.

expansion.trigger: Stage two only after stage-one integrity/resource gates and renewed explicit execution approval; independent of pair counts, decode success or favorable outcomes. Missing/unsupported windows stay assigned; never replace them. Integrity or resource failure stops the campaign for a decision.
expansion.evaluation_visibility: Acquisition and integrity accounting allowed only after approval. Evaluation outcomes sealed from analyst inspection until the B8 method and costs/evidence limits are frozen. Known old data never enter this reserve.

budget.max_paid_spend: 0; no paid service or credit use authorized
